sentences.text: Seven decisions wait on you, and the first is to approve the schema change so the import can run on real data; two agents have asked and nothing merges until you answer.
The week went better than the one before: 7 deliveries against 5, and 297k tokens per delivery against 332k, but work waited 421 hours against 67.
Most unusual: an ask from lead about whether the export ships in this release has waited 9 days, where such asks are usually answered in 7 h 30 min.
